mapper.select: SELECT shop_group_id, name FROM shop_group WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY shop_group_id
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_group SET name = #{name} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_group_id = #{shopGroupId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shop_group WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_group_id = #{shopGroupId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.shop_id FROM shop c JOIN shop_group p ON p.shop_group_id = c.shop_group_id AND p.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND p.name = #{defaultName} AND c.name = #{defaultName}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT figure_id) FROM figure WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_id IN (SELECT shop_id FROM shop WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_group_id = #{shopGroupId})
